## Overview

LRP204 is the no-interaction companion to [LRP104](../lrp-rli-mech-104/). It keeps the same letter-sound mechanism, word-reading outcome, subject random intercept and phonological-memory (RW) main effect, but sets `include_interaction=False`, so there is no letter-sound × RW `gamma_int` term.

The purpose is a nested comparison: LRP104 versus LRP204 asks whether the RW moderation improves predictive fit beyond the RW main effect (`compare_statistical_models.rw_moderation_loo_compare`). The mechanism curve and RW term remain adjusted associations, not causal effects.

## Model

$$
\eta = \alpha + \alpha_{\text{phase}} + \beta_G G
  + f^L(\operatorname{logit}_* L_{\text{post}})
  + \gamma_{\text{mod}} z(\text{RW})
  + \gamma_{\text{own}}\operatorname{logit}_*(W_{\text{pre}})
  + \gamma_A z(A) + \sum_c \gamma_c z(c) + u_{\text{child}}.
$$

The omitted term is the LRP104 interaction $\gamma_{\text{int}} z(\operatorname{logit}_* L_{\text{post}})\, z(\text{RW})$.
